podcast.body: This song from the *Lodger* album was later referenced as an important influence by Damon Albarn of Blur, leading to Blur being accused of plagiarism for one of their songs. "acabó invason un playtopor plagio de una de las canciones de Blur que estaba acusada de haber plagado por Skipshing in, que es una de las canciones del Lodger." (Note: "Skipshing in" is inferred to be "Boys Keep Swinging" based on context).
